decisions.reason: After a four-year trial, this adjustable quarter-pallet display remains close to the core range but its lack of recent visibility suggests results have not clearly met aspiration levels, so resources are better shifted to stronger core offers or new development.

The pegboard-backed cardboard display fits existing capabilities, but by 2022 a niche variant without visible momentum would likely be judged below aspiration relative to other display formats and be discontinued.
Because the eighth-pallet format serves a narrower retail use case and has had ample time to prove itself, management would likely redeploy capacity if its performance still trails aspiration.

The wooden display pallet is furthest from the firm's cardboard-centered routines and, after an extended test period without strong evidence of traction, is the clearest candidate for withdrawal and reallocation of resources.
